snippet.title: MetaStrike | Early Access | GamePlay PC
snippet.description:
MetaStrike is a first-person game, multiplayer team-playing be inspired by two blockbuster titles CSGO and COD.
So you will feel very familiar,easy to participating in MTS but that is not all, you will have countless other interesting experiences from many different game modes, different characters as well as other skills : shooting, self-improvement weapons ....and more.
